description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Mercado Eletrônico is hiring a Junior Forward Deployed Engineer to design, build, test, and evolve AI-powered prototypes, agents, and features with a product team. The role translates user journeys and business rules into working solutions and participates in user discovery before building.
Junior Forward Deployed Engineer building AI agent prototypes and React apps, comparing LLMs via OpenRouter and modeling data in Postgres and Supabase

Responsibilities:
• Build prototypes, agents, and AI-powered features with your POD, using Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex
• Turn user journeys and business rules into prompts, agent flows, and working React applications
• Integrate and compare language models through OpenRouter, choosing the best fit for each use case
• Test, evaluate, and iterate on agent behavior, including use cases, edge cases, and response quality
• Model and query data in Postgres and Supabase to bring prototypes to life
• Deploy and evolve prototypes and vibe apps on Vercel, with version control on GitLab
• Support the POD’s developer with API and service integrations in Golang
• Clearly document what was built, including prompts, decisions, flows, and lessons learned
• Take part in discovery sessions with users and the Product Builder to understand the problem before building
• Other duties assigned

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree (completed) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Design, or a related field
• Hands-on experience building something with AI, on your own or in projects: an agent, an app, an automation (we want to see it!)
• Practical use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex
• Basic programming logic and a real desire to learn to code
• Basic knowledge of Git
• Curiosity, autonomy, and comfort with failing fast and adjusting
• Good communication skills to explain what you built and why
• Fluency in Portuguese or Spanish is required

Preferred:
• Familiarity with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Golang
• Basic knowledge of SQL, Postgres, or Supabase
• Projects deployed on Vercel or similar platforms
• Experience using LLMs through APIs (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar)
• Basic knowledge of REST APIs and integrations
• Familiarity with prompt engineering and LLM evaluation
• Interest in product, UX, and B2B business
